Built **Skybound**, a complete, playable 2D flappy-bird-style game in `index.html`.

It features an animated bird, scrolling scenery, hand-drawn pipes, score and saved best score, sound controls, and a responsive layout with touch, click, and keyboard controls. I checked the page in-browser and confirmed the game script passes a syntax check.

**Assumption:** I made this a self-contained, single-page game with an original sky-and-meadow theme.
